text_simplified: The text includes a discussion about *tarbiyah* (the nurturing and upbringing of children) and teaching them religious and moral values. It highlights the importance of guiding children toward good behavior and deepening their understanding of the *deen* (religion). It also mentions some Prophetic *ahadith* (sayings of the Prophet ﷺ) that encourage kind and excellent treatment of children.

review_defects.why: The Arabic uses the ordinary word تربية (upbringing/education), but the English transliterates it as tarbiyah with a gloss, making the tone more academic and less direct than the simple Arabic.
تعزيز means strengthening/reinforcing, not deepening; the English changes the nuance.

review_defects.english: kind and excellent treatment of children
review_defects.why: The Arabic says حسن (good/kind) only; 'excellent' is an addition not present in the source.
